notes.title: Update - 1.0.7 - Tons more 360 videos from CS:GO and League of Legends
notes.content:
This update unleashes a torrent of new content! 

-- Browse videos by game, such as League of Legends, CS:GO, and more. 
-- The full rerun of ESL One New York is also now available!
-- Highlight videos of the best moments in ESL One NY!

Look for our next big Live Stream event coming soon!

notes.title: Update - 1.0.6
notes.content:
We just released an update before the big ESL One Live Stream this weekend. 

This version has:
-- Now includes RIFT SUPPORT!
-- Vastly improved streaming performance
-- More teaser video content

Look forward to more content and updates soon, and be sure to participate in the first ever live stream of CS:GO in VR this weekend - October 1st and 2nd!
